note: Hand-curated proposed future GTN node sites, not live sensors. Coordinates are draft sketches reasoned from the 3 existing stations' known lat/lon/elevation (see three_station_update_spec.md) — none of these have been field-surveyed with a GPS. Confirm on the ground before treating any of these as an install target.

locations.label: Lower Drainage Corridor
locations.rationale: Downhill and further east of HITHC-VALLEY-E, the property's lowest existing station (1065 ft vs. 1115/1148 ft on the two ridges) — likely along the natural runoff path off the property. Matches GTN's own upstream flash-flood-warning thesis (see docs/patent-ecosystem.md and ground-truth/10_gtn.html's Camp Mystic / Cypress Creek framing): a node here would see rising water before it reaches lower ground.

locations.label: West Ridge Extension
locations.rationale: A third ridgeline point west of the existing North Ridge / South Ridge pair, widening the array's baseline for the 2D wind-field and lightning-triangulation products GTN's own pitch deck cites as needing multiple ridge-spaced nodes.

locations.label: Approach Corridor Overlook
locations.rationale: Northeast of the existing cluster, along the likely small-aircraft approach vector this property already serves (see flight-routing.html / push-flight-conditions.py). A node here would extend gust/crosswind coverage into the approach path itself rather than only at the landing site.
